title: Act: Add validation, quota gating and submit states to ContributionSheet
summary: Client-side validation and submit state UI
description: Add MAX_PROMPT_LEN to the client and implement validation, disabled/loading submit and success feedback in handleSubmit.
acceptance_criteria: Empty and over-length text produce inline alerts without a fetch
technical_constraints: Count length with Array.from(prompt).length to match rune count

steps.action: Add a new exported constant mirroring backend MaxPromptLen in backend/internal/contribution/service.go.
Add state `const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false)` and `const [sending, setSending] = useState(false)`. Compute `const exhausted = remaining <= 0`. Import MAX_PROMPT_LEN.
steps.expected: Component tracks sending, success and exhausted

steps.action: After preventDefault: return early if exhausted or sending. Compute prompt = text.trim(). If prompt === '' call setError('Enter an idea before sending') and return. If Array.from(prompt).length > MAX_PROMPT_LEN call setError(`Ideas are limited to ${MAX_PROMPT_LEN} characters`) and return. Before the await call setSuccess(false) and setSending(true); on success setSuccess(true); on catch keep existing failed handling; in a finally block setSending(false).
steps.expected: Invalid input sets an alert and never calls submitContribution; valid input sets success after resolve

steps.action:
Set textarea disabled={exhausted || sending}. Set the submit button disabled={exhausted || sending} with text {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send'}. Below the form render

No contributions left

when exhausted, and

Idea sent

when success is true.
steps.expected: Send is disabled while sending or exhausted; status and exhausted message render
